title: Horizontal coefficient compatibility of native open evaluation
statement:
Let $l$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_l$ a finite field extension [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and put $A_k=\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E^{k+1}$, with the specified positive coefficient rings and quotient maps [def-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-data]. Let $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ be any open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion], using their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $J_j$ be native exact derived open extension on coefficient sequence-site modules [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], $e_k^W$ evaluation, and $\tau^W_{m,n}:e_m^W\to\operatorname{Res}_q e_n^W$ the actual horizontal transition for $n\le m$ and $q:A_m\to A_n$ [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition]. Define $\epsilon^j_k:J_j\mathbin{;}e_k^Z\cong e_k^X\mathbin{;}j_!^{A_k}$ to be native evalJ followed by the exact-derived compactSupportOpenModel comparison of [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. Let $\chi^j_q:j_!^{A_m}\operatorname{Res}_q\cong\operatorname{Res}_qj_!^{A_n}$ be the exact localization of the specified sfOpenRestriction [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. For every object $M$ of the ordinary unbounded derived coefficient-system category on $X$, one has
$$\tau^Z_{m,n,J_jM}\,;\,\operatorname{Res}_q(\epsilon^j_{n,M})=\epsilon^j_{m,M}\,;\,j_!^{A_m}(\tau^X_{m,n,M})\,;\,\chi^j_{q,e_n^XM},$$
where semicolon means composition in the written order. No cartesian-system condition, boundedness, flatness of $q$, compactification, or proper direct image is assumed; $m=n$ and $n=0$ are included.

source.place: Tag 03DI, lemma-extension-by-zero, direct-sum generators and adjunction; native compact-support transition proof, open step (step 1).

proof.text: Use compactSupportOrdinaryOpenTransition for the ordinary sequence-site module categories, with ordinary evaluation defined by the inverse of the unit-normalized native open mate and compactSupportOpenModel. This is the ordinary geometric square; it has no derived objects.

Identify the exact adjunction induced by homotopy-category localization with the right-derived adjunction transported through rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. Compare units on Qh-images, use the derived-unit factorization and the canonical right-derived comparison factorization, and cancel the exact localization factors. Localization natural-transformation extensionality gives equality of units, hence of adjunctions. Apply the exact-derived mate unit square to show that the inverse mate defining evalJInv is the localization of the ordinary inverse mate. Taking inverse isomorphisms and using the postcomposition coherence of mapDerivedCategoryNatIso identifies compactSupportNativeOpenEvaluation with mapDerivedCategorySquareIso of compactSupportOrdinaryOpenEvaluation.

Apply the ordinary geometric square degreewise to cochain complexes. Use the two compactSupportCoefficientTransition factorization equations and the exact-square localization factorization. Postcompose the proposed derived equation with the invertible evaluation, open-extension and scalar-restriction localization factors. Naturality moves those factors past the three comparisons, leaving Q of the degreewise ordinary square. Cancel them. Localization natural-transformation extensionality proves equality on every ordinary unbounded derived object. The exact-adjunction identification from the preceding step makes this the prescribed native equation, including its sfOpenRestriction factor.

from.place: Construct the coherent strict compact-support reduction tower before derived limits; native transition square, open-extension part.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportNativeOpenTransition
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (M : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E X) :
    (compactSupportCoefficientTransition l E Z h).app
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.J (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j).obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Z
        (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((compactSupportNativeOpenEvaluation l E j n).hom.app M) =
    (compactSupportNativeOpenEvaluation l E j m).hom.app M ≫
      (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (m + 1))).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((compactSupportCoefficientTransition l E X h).app M) ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso
        (sfOpenRestriction j (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h))).hom.app
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).obj M)
